name: Steel-Cut Oats (Coarse Whole Groat Mechanical Hazard Warning)
whyItWorks: Unlike rolled or quick oats which are steamed and flattened, steel-cut oats are chopped whole oat groats. Even after 30 minutes of boiling, they retain a dense, chewy, rubbery core that requires extensive enzymatic digestion and can irritate inflamed ileal strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture & Flare Warning: Avoid steel-cut and Irish oats during active disease. Substitute with smooth Quick 1-Minute Oats or Cream of Rice.
watchOuts: Dense, chewy, un-flattened groats resist digestion and can cause painful spasms and partial blockages.
